title: Qwen4-Max uses fewer tokens on Alibaba's own work test.
friendlyTitle: Alibaba's new model uses fewer tokens on its own work test.
summary: On 15 November, Alibaba introduced Qwen4-Max, a 2.4-trillion-parameter model that activates 71 billion per token, reads images, and takes a one-million-token window. On Alibaba's Work360 test, average cost per task fell from $4.43 to $1.67, and token use fell by about a quarter to a third versus Qwen3.8-Max. Those figures are Alibaba's.
friendlySummary: On 15 November, Alibaba released Qwen4-Max. It is a very large model that uses only part of itself for each word, can read images, and can take a very long document. On Alibaba's own work test, the average cost of a task fell from $4.43 to $1.67. It also used fewer tokens than the previous model. Those numbers are Alibaba's.
whyItMatters: A cheaper long job is useful only on work that looks like yours, and only if you can check the result. The saving is on Alibaba's own benchmark, not a receipt. A lower price per task still leaves the spreadsheet, the code, or the memo for a person to read before it goes out.
